name: Onboarding Tour renders the seeded tour without a model call
description: From the sidebar, opens the Onboarding Tour of the seeded acme/payments-api repo. The seed stores a ready tour (server/src/db/seed-onboarding.ts) and the repo has no clone, so the page shows the five sections from stored data and Regenerate is disabled with 'Clone the repository to regenerate'. No 'Generate onboarding tour' control is shown, so no model can be called. Read-only. Waits on card-only seed content because the table of contents repeats the section titles. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
